title: rpl_dao_process.c:445-446: dao_targets_authorized doc comment still carries the repudiated 'flags ignored' phrasing
description: Codereview pass 2 (security) on blwt found a residual one function away from the pointer blwt's fix adds. lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c:444-446 — dao_targets_authorized's doc comment says 'canonicalized per 8.7.1: reserved flags and bits beyond the Prefix Length are ignored' with no mention of 8.6 R-05-035. The function body (~lines 476-479) indeed never checks opt.data[0], so the text is locally descriptive of canonicalization — but blwt's new messages.c comment now directs readers to rpl_dao_process.c as the flag-semantics authority, and a reader can land on the gate's 'flags are ignored' text before seeing the accurate extract-loop comment at rpl_dao_process.c:154-163. Behavior is fail-closed today (extract_updates rejects nonzero flags at :164 before any route-state mutation), so this is comment-only, not a security hole. Fix: extend the gate's doc comment to note the reserved Target Flags octet is enforced at semantic ingest per 8.6 R-05-035 (nonzero rejects the DAO), scoping 'ignored' to canonicalization only. Note: pass-3 reviewer disagreed (judged the two comments consistently layer-scoped); filed per protocol since pass-2 flagged it — adjudicate on fix. Pre-existing; discovered from blwt.
